book_of_two_ways.object: Middle Kingdom Coffin Text route-map tradition; British Museum EA30842 is an example
book_of_two_ways.mechanic_used_as_inspiration: Represent traversal as explicit ways/routes and use route identity to guide or refuse passage

frozen_operator.name: PT477_V2_APEP_TWO_WAYS_ROUTE_TOMBSTONE
frozen_operator.purpose: Remember a route class only after that route has already failed the exact Buzz return gate, then refuse repeated approaches to that same no-go class before expensive canonicalization.
frozen_operator.route_identity: Incremental local route token derived only from metadata already computed by the parent search step: parent signed seed signature, parent maximum branch-variable frequency, and branch Boolean value. No additional CNF/residual scan is permitted to build this token.

ritual_to_code_mapping.NAME_OR_DRAW: construct local Book-of-Two-Ways route token from already-computed parent metadata
ritual_to_code_mapping.BIND: insert a negative tombstone only after an exact Buzz failure / HAWKING_ESCAPE
ritual_to_code_mapping.CUT: remove tombstoned candidate route from the candidate list before current residual canonicalization
ritual_to_code_mapping.BURN: do not retry that tombstoned route-class pair for the remainder of the run
ritual_to_code_mapping.ASH_MEMORY: retain the negative certificate/tombstone in the ledger; do not erase evidence or solver state

frozen_operator.authority_boundary: A tombstone can only refuse a cache-merge attempt. It can never authorize reuse, SAT, UNSAT, equivalence, or absorption.
frozen_operator.false_negative_policy: A conservative refusal of a potentially valid merge is logically safe but is counted as a performance regression if it increases states, resolution work, or loses certified absorptions.

promotion_gates.charged_work_proxy_definition: resolution_attempts + signed_refinement_edge_visits + q0_fallback_refinement_edge_visits + tombstone_checks + tombstone_inserts + route_token_updates
